ja: 1日しか時間がない人には、どのツアーがおすすめですか？
en: Which tour would you recommend for someone who has only one day?
alternatives: Which tour would you suggest for someone with just one day?
Which tour do you recommend for someone who only has one day?
point: 「1日しか時間がない人」は someone who has only one day と後ろから説明

ja: 夜のツアーのほうが高いけど、景色はずっといいですよ。
en: The night tour is more expensive, but the view is much better.
alternatives: The night tour costs more, but the view is much better.
The night tour is pricier, but the views are far better.
point: 比較級を強めるのは very ではなく much

ja: 展望台が混みすぎていて、私はいい写真が撮れませんでした。
en: The observation deck was so crowded that I couldn't get a good photo.
alternatives: I couldn't take a good picture because the observation deck was too crowded.
The observation deck was too crowded for me to get a good photo.
point: 「〜すぎて〜できなかった」は so 〜 that 主語 couldn't で表す

ja: 有名なお寺を夕暮れ時に見るために、私たちははるばるここまで来たんです。
en: We came all the way here to see the famous temple at sunset.
alternatives: We came all this way to see the famous temple at sunset.
We traveled all the way here to see the famous temple at dusk.
point: 目的の「〜するために」は to + 動詞の原形

ja: チケットを持っていなくても、庭園には入れますよ。
en: Even if you don't have a ticket, you can still enter the garden.
alternatives: You can still get into the garden even if you don't have a ticket.
Even without a ticket, you can still go into the garden.
point: 「〜しても」は even if、even だけでは節をつなげない

ja: この近くにいい博物館はありますか？
en: Is there a good museum near here?
alternatives: Is there a good museum nearby?
Is there a good museum around here?
Are there any good museums around here?
point: 「ありますか」は Is there で始める

ja: 城のツアーは毎朝10時に始まります。
en: The castle tour starts at ten every morning.
alternatives: The castle tour begins at ten every morning.
The tour of the castle starts at 10 every morning.
point: 主語 The castle tour は三人称単数なので starts
